name: auto-model
description: Picks opus, sonnet or haiku for a session from its first prompt, and keeps the main conversation on it until you switch with /model.

classifierModel.title: Classifier model
classifierModel.description: The model that reads the first prompt and picks the session's model.

fallbackModel.title: Fallback model
fallbackModel.description: The model the session runs on when the classifier fails, times out or answers with no tier.

timeoutSeconds.title: Classifier timeout (seconds)
timeoutSeconds.description: How long the first prompt waits on the classifier before the fallback model is taken.
